system.longDesc: Your magic is rarely what it appears to be. In general, illusion spells resisted by Perception affect machines and artificial sensors as well as living beings, whereas illusions resisted by Willpower (such as hallucination) have no effect on sensors like camera or microphones, only on a living mind.
system.requirement: Power talent: Intelligence (Illusion Arcana) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Illusion Arcana spells.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Illusion Arcana spell. You also gain the power focus Intelligence (Illusion Arcana).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Illusion Arcana spell. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Illusion Arcana spells for –1 SP.
